📁 Local build output

The deployable extension payload comes from:

src\TwitchHeists.StreamerBot.Bridge\bin\Release\net48\

The Streamer.bot import file lives at:

TwitchHeists.txt

📦 What you normally deploy

  • The full bridge release output folder contents
  • The runtimes\ folder inside that output
  • The JSON files that live beside the DLLs
  • TwitchHeists.txt imported separately in Streamer.bot

🗂️ Main TwitchHeists files

  • TwitchHeists.StreamerBot.Bridge.dll
  • TwitchHeists.StreamerBot.dll
  • TwitchHeists.Core.dll
  • TwitchHeists.Data.Sqlite.dll
  • appsettings.json
  • heist-messages.json
